I hired Chris to DJ and MC our wedding reception. I found Chris through a popular wedding planning website. I chose Chris because his pricing was competitive and he actually responded to messages.

I sent several estimate requests to different DJs and I only heard from a couple of DJs. Chris responded to messages quickly and also helped me with the planning of the reception schedule of events with a sample schedule. His music selection is huge and he has his entire music catalog online that you can browse and build a playlist that you can send to Chris.  Again, Chris kept constant email contact with me, even if it was a short message confirming that he received my messages.

Of course, I arrived at the reception long after Chris had set up. As I approached the reception room I could hear the music playing and I was relieved. Music really makes the party legit. When I walked in to the reception with my bride and sat down, I made eye contact with Chris and he gave me the “I’m here for you bud” nod.

He played all the music that we requested on the list and even worked to keep the party jumping all night long. My guests commented on how good the music was and how fun the dance floor was with all of the flashing lights.

At the end Chris kept jamming away and even carried on for about ten minutes over time, taking a couple of final drunk requests.  Chris helped make our special day amazing. Thank you Chris!

Chris is an amazing DJ. He was a referral from one of my co-workers who also hired him for their wedding. I have been working with Chris over the last year (since my engagement), and the entire process was professional, knowledgeable, kind, and he even has a sense of humor. I researched a lot of DJ’s before I contacted Chris, and he is reasonably priced. He traveled all the way to Sacramento for my wedding, along with his DJ equipment, awesome dance floor lighting, and a photo booth. His props for the booth were awesome, my guests had so much fun! He even encouraged people to get in there and have fun! I provided him with a list of songs for our wedding, he had every song we wanted, and some with a better remix version that I have never heard! He can mix up songs for a dance party and keep everyone on the dance floor! I was surprised by that. He even helped us in areas we forgot about. Chris has a lot of experience as a DJ, and truly enjoys what he does. He is made for this business. My maid of honor and bridesmaid surprised me with a performance during her speech; Chris coordinated with the girls without me knowing and everything went off perfectly! Not only do I appreciate his reliability and being a man of his word, but what I really enjoyed most was his suggestions for me throughout the process, and I truly appreciate that as planning a wedding can be overwhelming at times. Chris went above and beyond his job to ensure I had the perfect music, entertainment and lighting for my wedding. He responds promptly, provides great advice and has a nice smile for your guests.

I recommend Chris as your DJ for any event! Especially a wedding!

P.S. He gave me a USB with alllllll of the photo booth photos on it for the groom and I to keep. I thought that was a really special unique touch. We had so much fun looking at all of the photos after the wedding. The photo booth also prints out two strips of photos, so one strip of photos the guests take home, and the other strip of photos we had our guests use a glue stick to place in our guestbook and write in a message! Genius!!! Thank you again Chris!!

    We hired Chris for our Wedding on Saturday, June 7, 2014.

    We had a lunch reception of about 200 people which consisted of our family, family friends and parents friends.  It was an older group and Chris did a great job of feeling the crowd and playing quieter, tamed music as well as kid friendly since there were almost 20 kids.

    We then had a dinner reception with all of our friends – essentially 100 people mid 20s to late 30s.  We requested the music to be a little different than lunch as it was a different crowd and we were going for a different vibe.  My husband and I were sooo happy we went with Chris!

    1. He was paying attention the entire time! I’m sure Chris does this ALL the time, so I was really impressed he actually listened to my fathers 10 minute speech as well as all of our bridal party toasts.  (when references were made in toasts, Chris would play relevant music seconds later – not sure how many people noticed, but my husband and i thought this was a very nice touch)

    2. Chris was very easy to work with and easy going during the entire process.  He asked for guidance in the beginning, and it took us longer than expected to get him a list of songs to go off of – and we were a bit fickle, but he was very patient and never pushy.  Always very responsive with quick replies.

    3. Our lunch reception went relatively according to plan and Chris was always paying attention and on top of what our emcee was doing.  Our dinner reception spiraled into a drunk fun mess pretty quickly, last minute we shortened our father daughter song AND we changed our first dance song and Chris did a great job just rolling with it.

    4. Lastly, my husband and I just really wanted to have fun at our wedding and we wanted our guests to have fun too – the music was amazing! Chris definitely felt the crowd and there was dancing going on the ENTIRE time!!!

    While we were wedding planning, we were really trying to keep it budgeted and cut costs where we could.  After a lot of thought and consideration, we decided to hire Chris and we felt he was worth every penny!  Would definitely recommend him!

    Thanks Chris!
